name: Re:Zero - After Memories
source:
Natsuki Subaru wakes up exactly one day after the events of the first season of Re:Zero - Starting Life in Another World... or is it? Back in a familiar land, can Subaru really be sure he hasn't Returned by Death to a previous time?

Revisit familiar faces from the hit series as Subaru goes on a quest to find out in this one-shot fan fiction visual novel.
translation:
菜月昴在《Re：从零开始的异世界生活》第一季事件发生的第二天醒来……是这样吗？回到熟悉的土地，昴真的能确定自己没有死而复生吗？

在这部一次性同人小说视觉小说中，斯巴鲁继续探索热门剧集中的熟悉面孔，寻找答案。
